PROMOTION IS REFUSED BY tools/tubuild.py promote --dry-run, and the TU is banked text-verified rather than promoted. The two printed reasons are 'manifest status is not link-verified or data-verified' and 'the promotion-ready status is not the recorded linkcheck result'. The recorded result is `scratch-link-verified`, which promotion_refusals() can never accept: it demands status in (link-verified, data-verified) AND linkcheck.result == status, while classify_link_result() returns the `scratch-` prefix whenever the compiler-only policy rewrites the object before the link -- which it does for every key-function TU, this one included (it deadstrips _ZN16daKing_Donketu_cD2Ev, _ZN7Vector3D1Ev and eleven typeinfo/vtable records). Census of config/tu_manifest.d on this tree: 213 manifests, 182 promoted, 169 of those carrying compiler_only_output, 80 promoted entries recording exactly this `scratch-*` result, and only 2 entries in the whole tree satisfying status == recorded result -- neither of them promoted. cmd_promote also has no mutating path at all: anything but --dry-run exits 2. The refusal is therefore structural to the gate, not a defect in this TU, and clearing it is a tools change that belongs in its own review.
